references.text: The fulfillment of this promise where the Israelites were asked to ask for silver and gold items from the Egyptians, and the Lord gave the people favor with the Egyptians.

The actual implementation of this promise when the Israelites asked the Egyptians for silver and gold items and clothing, and the Lord gave them favor so that the Egyptians gave them what they asked for.
God's promise to Abraham that his descendants would come out of slavery with great wealth, which is fulfilled here.
The psalmist's description of the exodus from Egypt where the Israelites came out with silver and gold, and none in their tribes stumbled.
The use of the word 'נִצַּלְתֶּם' (to plunder/take spoil) which is also used in Ezekiel regarding taking spoil from enemies.
This is the immediate precursor to 3:22 and describes the same event with identical instructions about plundering the Egyptians.
